title: Best Digital Marketing Training Company
presentedBy: Shri Yogendra Upadhyay, Minister for Higher Education, Uttar Pradesh
description: DIDM was officially recognised and felicitated as the 'Best Digital Marketing Training Company' at the Noida Education Conclave 2026. The award was presented by Shri Yogendra Upadhyay, Minister for Higher Education, Uttar Pradesh, recognizing DIDM's 10+ years of pioneering digital marketing education, hands-on live project training, and generative AI curriculum integration.

title: Fair Business Practices Award 2023
organization: ASSOCHAM (Associated Chambers of Commerce and Industry of India)
presentedBy: ASSOCHAM Apex Trade Leadership & Union Ministry Dignitaries
description: In a historic milestone, DIDM was honored by ASSOCHAM for the third consecutive time in a row. Having previously won the Most Promising Brand award and the Eminent Fair Business Practices award, this 9th MSME Excellence Award reaffirmed DIDM's transparent course fee structures, ethical 100% placement support commitments, and student-first governance.

title: Eminent Fair Business Practices Award
organization: ASSOCHAM (Associated Chambers of Commerce and Industry of India)
category: Fair Business Practices Category of the Year
presentedBy: Mr. Bhanu Pratap Singh Verma, Minister of State, Ministry of MSME, Govt. of India
description: On 9 March 2022 at the Taj Mahal Hotel in New Delhi, DIDM received the prestigious and eminent Fair Business Practices Category of the Year Award at the 8th ASSOCHAM MSMEs Excellence Awards Ceremony & Summit. The award was handed over by Union Minister Mr. Bhanu Pratap Singh Verma and covered by Business Standard.

title: Best Digital Marketing Training Company
category: Premier Digital Marketing Institute in India
description: DIDM bagged the prestigious International Fame Awards 2021 and was declared the 'Best Digital Marketing Training Company' across India. Celebrated actor and humanitarian Sonu Sood presented the trophy to the founders of DIDM, recognizing the institute's scale, student career transformations, and practical learning methodology.

title: Best Digital Marketing Training Company
organization: World Association for Small and Medium Enterprises (WASME)
presentedBy: WASME International Governing Board & Ministry Leaders
description: On Thursday, December 23, 2021 at Mirza Ghalib Hall, SCOPE Convention Complex, Lodhi Road, New Delhi, WASME conferred the SME Excellence Award upon Delhi Institute of Digital Marketing. The honor was reported in The Economic Times for DIDM's contribution towards training micro-entrepreneurs and skilled agency personnel.

title: Most Promising Digital Marketing Institute
organization: ASSOCHAM (Associated Chambers of Commerce and Industry of India)
category: Most Promising Brand in Digital Marketing
description: In 2018, competing against over 200 digital training organizations across India, DIDM stood out for curriculum rigor, classroom infrastructure, and practical pedagogy. ASSOCHAM recognized DIDM as the 'Most Promising Digital Marketing Institute of 2018', marking the beginning of DIDM's multi-year national recognition by the apex body.

title: Most Searched Digital Marketing Institute Across Delhi NCR
description: Recognized by Justdial as the #1 most-searched and highest-rated digital marketing training institute across Delhi NCR based on verified student inquiries, authentic 4.8/5 review ratings, and campus visit requests.

title: Award for Excellence in Digital Marketing
description: Honored by Franchise Batao for building an exemplary franchised education network across North India with uniform pedagogical quality, robust trainer certification, and high alumni employment ratios.
